claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User selects a Treatment Form Number from the list of claim receipt details that have not yet been entered into the system.
Upon selection of the Treatment Form Number, the system automatically populates the Submitted Date and VSP Name fields. The Date of submission should be the current date.

Based on the entered Voucher No, the system automatically populates Client Details (Address as per Claim Form), Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test Details, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, and Partner Treated fields; the user is not allowed to alter any auto-populated treatment information.
The MSIU Field Office User enters the No of Mentioned Forms and No of Available Forms.
The MSIU Field Office User manually enters the Patient Name and Age and selects the Gender from the options Male/Female.
The MSIU Field Office User enters the Street/Road manually and selects District, Sub-District, County, etc. from master records for the Address field.
The MSIU Field Office User selects the Doctor Name from a list populated from the VSP Staff Master and may optionally enter a Doctor's Note.
The system captures the remaining master claim information, including Visit Count, Patient Type, Contact No, HIV Details, and Claim Status.
The MSIU Field Office User selects the Patient Status from a list of status options.
The system calculates the Claim Amount based on the visit type.
The system records the entered claim information in its database.

claims.content: To enter claim information exactly into the system from the manual claim form.
A manual claim form (Treatment Form) submitted by the VSP is available to the MSIU Field Office User.
The MSIU Field Office User has access to the Claim Entry / Processing module of the Voucher Management System.
The system has the MSIU treatment master available to support entry of Syndrome, Clinical Examinations, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Drugs and Other Measures.
When a manual claim form is available, the MSIU Field Office User initiates claim registration by entering the claim information from the manual claim form into the system.
The MSIU Field Office User selects a Treatment Form Number from the list of claim receipt details that have not yet been entered into the system.
Upon selection of the Treatment Form Number, the system automatically populates the Submitted Date and VSP Name fields. The Date of submission should be the current date.

Based on the entered Voucher No, the system automatically populates Client Details (Address as per Claim Form), Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test Details, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, and Partner Treated fields; the user is not allowed to alter any auto-populated treatment information.
The MSIU Field Office User enters the No of Mentioned Forms and No of Available Forms.
The MSIU Field Office User manually enters the Patient Name and Age and selects the Gender from the options Male/Female.
The MSIU Field Office User enters the Street/Road manually and selects District, Sub-District, County, etc. from master records for the Address field.
The MSIU Field Office User selects the Doctor Name from a list populated from the VSP Staff Master and may optionally enter a Doctor's Note.
The system captures the remaining master claim information, including Visit Count, Patient Type, Contact No, HIV Details, and Claim Status.
The MSIU Field Office User selects the Patient Status from a list of status options.
The system calculates the Claim Amount based on the visit type.
The system records the entered claim information in its database.

If details required for the Address field (such as District, Sub-District, County) are not present in the Master record, the system provides a provision to navigate quickly to its master screen to enter the new details and then return to the Claim Entry Screen.
